cohort: The study utilized vital records linked to maternal hospital discharge records for singleton births, forming four cohorts: all-births, randomly selected one birth per individual, first-observed birth per individual, and primiparous-births.
finding: The study found that different cohort selection and analytic approaches significantly impacted maternal characteristics, outcome prevalence (lowest among all-births and highest among primiparous-births), and risk ratio estimates, particularly when comparing primiparous-births to other cohorts.
